bio: Kasteel Van Ordingen, a Michelin key, is home to a romantic restaurant, Aurum, that mingles medieval charm and intimacy. Classicism reigns throughout, albeit in an updated culinary version. Seafood and local produce are the stars of this contemporary, refined score. The chef may exalt chicory from Scherpenheuvel with layers of textured cheese and mushrooms; he is also equally capable of concocting creative desserts that revolve around pumpkins, laced with coffee and vanilla. His multi-faceted recipes never fail to keep us on our toes. We recommend checking out the special deals and packages to combine a fine dining experience with an overnight stay....
